reason: A task-completion notification plugin that monitors session events and sends configurable result summaries and usage metrics to external notification channels.

summaries.zh: 监听任务回合结束事件，并将结果摘要、耗时和使用统计发送到配置的 Server酱、钉钉、飞书或通用 Webhook。
summaries.en: Monitors task completion events and sends result summaries, duration, and usage metrics to configured ServerChan, DingTalk, Feishu, or generic webhook endpoints.

capabilities: subscribes to session and turn-end events
summarizes task results and usage metrics
sends notifications to configured ServerChan, DingTalk, Feishu, or generic webhook endpoints
flushes pending notifications when the process exits
